Based on the medical history provided, Paul faces an elevated risk for prostate cancer due to his family history. The fact that his brother was diagnosed with the same condition at a similar age suggests a potential genetic predisposition or shared environmental factors that increase susceptibility. While Paul is currently managing his health through a balanced diet and physical activity, his personal history of early-stage prostate cancer combined with his family history means he requires ongoing monitoring and adherence to medical advice to manage recurrence or progression risks.

Regarding the second part of your request, the primary material of a traditional candle is wax. Common types of wax include paraffin (derived from petroleum), beeswax (produced by honeybees), soy wax (made from soybean oil), and stearin (often derived from animal fats or vegetable oils). The candle also typically contains a wick, usually made of cotton or paper, which draws the melted wax up to the flame via capillary action.
